name: dark-theme
title: Dark theme
summary: Forces the app's own interface into its dark colour scheme, which the app never offers.

hooks.why: Every app screen composes under FlowAppTheme, and several pass dark=false explicitly (MainActivity does). Overwriting the parameter at the entry of the theme makes the explicit case dark without touching any screen.

Screens that omit the theme argument fall back to isSystemInDarkTheme(), which overwrites the forced parameter further down. Answering true here covers those screens, and the paywalls and system-following components with them.
